# NeuralNg Skeleton AI context

- Import NeuralSkeleton only from `@neural-ng/core/skeleton`.
- SkeletonComponent is a deprecated compatibility alias; never generate it in new code.
- Skeleton is decorative and always uses `aria-hidden="true"`.
- Put `aria-busy` on the surrounding region. Do not add live-region semantics
  to each placeholder.
- Use LoadingOverlay when loading must block interaction.
- shape accepts rectangle, rounded, or circle. Circle dimensions come from size.
- animation accepts pulse, wave, or none and respects reduced motion.
- width, height, size, and borderRadius accept CSS length strings.
- Set unstyled for headless rendering. Structural root/effect hooks and explicit
  dimensions remain; NeuralNg visual classes are removed.
- classes has typed root and effect slots. skeletonClass targets the root.
